name: virtualfit-ai
description: VirtualFit AI - Intelligent Virtual Dressing Room (noncommercial university project)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @virtualfit/api" "npm run dev -w @virtualfit/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @virtualfit/api && npm run build -w @virtualfit/web
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others -n api,web "npm run start -w @virtualfit/api" "npm run start -w @virtualfit/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @virtualfit/api && npm run typecheck -w @virtualfit/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @virtualfit/shared && npm run test -w @virtualfit/api && npm run test -w @virtualfit/web
scripts.dev:slm: concurrently --kill-others -n slm,app "npm run slm:serve" "npm run dev"
